practiceReport.beatComment: Brents was hurt in the fourth quarter and is uncertain to re-enter the contest. Darrell Baker has taken over for Brents at outside cornerback.

practiceReport.name: Aaron Brewer
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (7th NFL season, 100% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
practiceReport.beatComment: Brewer missed last Sunday's game against Indianapolis due to a concussion, but he's since cleared the NFL's five-step protocol, including being cleared by an independent neurologist. As such, the All-Pro will be able to return to his usual role as the anchor of Miami's offensive line at center.

practiceReport.name: Jonah Savaiinaea
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (92% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Savaiinaea injured his ankle in the second quarter, but the second-year pro is back on the field for the start of the second half. He'll return to his normal spot at right guard while Jarrett Kingston shifts to the sidelines.

practiceReport.name: Darrell Baker Jr.
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (CB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Baker had been on the reserve/PUP list all season before being activated Saturday. He logged a week of full practices, which led to the veteran cornerback being active for what will be his Dolphins debut Sunday. Baker may initially work in a rotational role behind starters JuJu Brents and Jason Marshall.

practiceReport.name: Chris Bell
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (WR) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Bell suffered a chest injury late in the first half and was subsequently deemed questionable to return. However, the rookie wideout got back into the game shortly after halftime. Bell will look to be more productive after finishing the first half without a reception.

practiceReport.name: Andrew Meyer
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (C) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Meyer suffered a stinger against the Colts in Week 10, but his full practice Friday was enough for him to avoid an injury tag for Sunday's AFC East game. He would likely start at center for a second consecutive week if Aaron Brewer (concussion) is not cleared to play.
